worldcombat.skill.bestow.summary: Pass your held item to an empty-handed ally: the gift flies along the line and lands in their item slot, leaving you empty-handed. It fails if the target already holds an item or is embargoed.
worldcombat.skill.bestow.use.0: Give a Berry or similar item to an ally that needs it
worldcombat.skill.bestow.use.1: Hand your item to your main attacker before the fight
worldcombat.skill.bestow.use.2: Transfer your item to an empty-handed partner
worldcombat.skill.bestow.description.0: Pass the gift to an empty-handed ally within %1$s blocks; %2$s s wind-up. It only gives, never takes back.
worldcombat.skill.bestow.description.1: About %1$s ribbons carry the gift across, and about %2$s motes of light rise on the ally; higher friendship shines brighter.
worldcombat.skill.bestow.urgent.on: Urgent on: reach x0.8, wind-up -3 ticks and cooldown -10 ticks; you must close in, but the gift arrives fast.
worldcombat.skill.bestow.urgent.off: Urgent off: reach x1.15, wind-up +3 ticks and cooldown +10 ticks; the gift can be handed over from a short distance.
worldcombat.skill.bestow.timing: Cast within %1$s blocks; after %2$s seconds of preparation it costs %4$s PP, then %3$s seconds of recovery and a %5$s second cooldown from commit.
worldcombat.skill.bestow.growth.0: At level %1$s the reach rises to %2$s blocks.
worldcombat.skill.bestow.growth.1: At level %1$s the reach rises to %2$s blocks and the ribbons to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.bestow.preference.urge: On = urgent: reach x0.8, wind-up -3 and cooldown -10, close range but fast. Off = formal: reach x1.15, wind-up +3 and cooldown +10, handed over from a short distance. Reach trades against speed.
worldcombat.skill.bestow.preference.ai.m: The companion passes the gift only to an ally within this distance; smaller means only at close range, larger means running a stretch to deliver.
worldcombat.skill.bestow.preference.ai.g: Default 1.0: hand the item to an empty-handed ally before the fight. Lower it to give only when the ally drops below that health ratio, saving the gift for a more dangerous moment.
worldcombat.skill.bestow.preference.ai.l: On: a holding companion will leave its post to deliver a gift. Off: it hands it over only where it already stands.
world_combat.move.bestow.text.sealed: They are embargoed and cannot receive
